title: Carousel storyboard
description: Every visible string of a carousel, written and gated before any image exists. Lives at carousels/<YYYY-MM-DD-slug>/storyboard.json. See engine/spines.md.

style.description: Style card id from engine/styles (e.g. S03); null until the user picks

format.description: carousel (default): 5 slides or more. single: a one-image post with exactly one slide, for a style with a one-page layout such as S27 Icon-Grid Cheat Sheet; its gates are in engine/spines.md ('Format single'). The minimum-slides rule is relaxed for single only

keyword.description: CTA comment keyword, identical on slide, caption and comment-to-DM automation

intent.description: What a cold reader must be able to recover from the slide text alone (gate G8)

glossary.description: Every term a cold viewer may not know, with the slide where it is defined (gate G3)

slides.description: At least 5 slides, or exactly 1 when format is single (see allOf). At most one slide has star: true

role.description: Spine role: cover what why model how peak use start cta paper context test verdict item combo parts step day

lesson.description: The one idea this slide teaches

strings.description: Every visible string on the slide, verbatim, with placement and intended occurrence count

place.description: Where the string sits on the slide. Three values are reserved: "headline" (every line of the headline), "counter" (the NN / TT page counter) and "chrome" (the brand header or footer). They are handled specially: the cold reader prints the slide's headline field once and skips headline and counter strings, and shows a chrome string only on the first slide where it appears; the brief card leaves all three out of its "everything else on the slide" column. Any other value is free-form (eyebrow, body, caption, panel-label, ...).

describe.description: One-line panel caption; also fed to the cold reader

source.description: verified-facts id, capture path, video timestamp, or URL

production.description: Set at Make time from the style card

layout.description: The style card's layout for this slide (optional; the role still sets the job). Values per style: S16 overview-cover | system-cover | explain | compare | proof | parts | inspector | uses | payoff | cta (its 'Layouts by role'). S20 cover | family | proof-family | mix | cta. S22 atlas (the template's layout:'atlas'; the role picks the layer, index, combo or CTA sheet). S23 before-after | capture | chart-audit | split | triptych | plain | cta. S24 cover | dossier | proof | verdict | cta. S25 cover | step | definition | rows | cta. S27 cover | item | combo | cta. S28 cover | item | before-after | combo | cta. Any other style: the layout names in its engine/styles/<id>-*.prompt.md

cards.description: HTML cards rendered with shared/render-card.mjs and pasted into this slide's zones (S23, S24 and other hybrid styles)

zone.description: Zone the card fills: a magenta/cyan zone number from composite.py --zones-only, or a named zone

html.description: Card file, relative to the deck folder (e.g. cards/numbers-03.html)

size.description: [w, h] in CSS px: the zone's --zones-only out bbox; render-card runs --w w --h h --scale 2

star.description: The item the cover payoff leans on. At most one per deck; S23 needs exactly one

beam.description: S24 stage-beam colour: one per item slide; cover and CTA list every item's colour in order

gates.description: G1..G8 results from engine/spines.md: {G1: {pass: bool, note: str}, ...}

beam.description: S24 beams: amber #E8A33D, sage #8FAF6E, apricot (from Claude orange #D9551F), kraft #B08A62

graph.description: S16 node pipeline: one source for the kit, the stopgap prompts and QA (count nodes, diamonds, branches and the loop against it). Every node label is also a strings[] entry, verbatim, and the labels go into evidence.describe for the cold reader

rows.description: Node ids top to bottom, one array per row, left to right (1-4 nodes a row; the layout caps rows and nodes). Badges run 1 to N in this reading order

label.description: 3 words or fewer (2 on the image-native stopgap); never Input / Output / Process

kind.description: step: circle · decision: diamond · tool: tool node carrying a real logo

icon.description: Lucide glyph name from shared/vendor/lucide/ (step and decision nodes)

logo.description: Real logo file for a tool node, e.g. logos/claude-white.png; never drawn

state.description: Rail state on inspector/step slides: done, live (current, in the accent) or ghost (later)

sub.description: Optional sub-label (parts diagram), 8 words or fewer

kind.description: taken: beaded connector · ghost: dashed path not taken

loop.description: At most one loop: a beaded arc on the right from a later node back to an earlier one

tag.description: 3 words or fewer, e.g. 'until it passes'
